Method of Attack: Remote access malware that hides on Nginx servers by injecting into Nginx processes to remain undetected
Hides payloads in tasks scheduled to execute on an invalid day of the calendar
Modifies server-side code to record data submitted by users (POST requests)
Delivered via custom 'dwn' command that downloads malicious Linux system library and injects it using LD_PRELOAD
Hijacks host Nginx application by modifying core Linux host system functionality (e.g., dlopen interception)
Attack Vector: Scheduled tasks with invalid calendar days (CronRAT)
Use of LD_PRELOAD and LD_L1BRARY_PATH environment variables to load malicious shared libraries
Indicators of Compromise: Presence of LD_PRELOAD and LD_L1BRARY_PATH environment variables in process environments
Cron tasks scheduled on invalid calendar days
Impacted Systems: Servers in the U.S., Germany, and France
